config.design: 16 adjective pairs (4 familiar anchors,12 new to H962/H966 panel) x4 templates x4 factorial states. Four predeclared lexicon cohorts of4 pairs. Templates separately test original film prompt, movie noun, book noun, and Overall sentiment output wording. No post-outcome prompt replacement or individual correctness selection.
config.gate: Per template/lexicon cohort >=4 quartets, >=.75 all-four binary correct and >=.5 pooled full-vocabulary intended-group top1, same as H966. Report state-specific correctness and all failed cohorts.
config.frozen_candidate: Adjective-last-subtoken MLP3 local and total factorial interaction; period MLP4 native-write rescue and attention5 source transport. No layer selection or formula tuning on this panel. Future teacher-quartet coefficients remain privileged, not a frozen learned encoder.
config.novelty: New adjective pairs are checked against H962 task-bank and H966 panels, not asserted unseen in all historical research or model training. Original-format anchor quartets intentionally overlap.
config.semantics: Ideal binary valence=a*n remains an operational expectation; not-negative phrases can be neutral or weakly positive. Native failures do not prove abstract inability.
config.capture: Save native logits plus adjective MLP3 normalized input/write and period MLP4 write for locked follow-up interventions. No training, interventions or reserved-test access in this screen.
